title: Ping Services Stub
summary: One stub exercising every shared Ping service: local shared PingFederate, PingGateway, Privilege Agent Gateway, PingOne SaaS, PingOne Privilege console, and the SE-K8s PingFederate. One real, read-only call per service.
audience: SEs and demo builders verifying the shared stack after setup
